purpose: Define deterministic local/package Contract Format source resolution without fallback to the retired canonical/json bootstrap path.

does_not_own: filesystem semantics beyond declared bootstrap bindings

topics.name: Bootstrap Source Resolution
topics.purpose: Define deterministic local/package Contract Format source resolution without fallback to the retired canonical/json bootstrap path.

priority: project/package root exact Contract Format filename
bundled exact Contract Format artifact where the tool contract permits it
semantics.exact_rule: Resolution is exact and version/profile-aware; no fuzzy filename search.
semantics.failure_rule: No valid bootstrap source produces explicit hard failure.
semantics.local_rule: Local-source resolution cannot reinterpret an ordinary canonical contract as the format authority.
semantics.provenance_rule: Resolved bootstrap source/path/hash/version is retained in validation/build evidence.

invariants.rule: Contract Format bootstrap authority is resolved before the canonical contract tree and is never treated as an ordinary canonical contract inside canonical/json/**.

hard_gates.condition: legacy canonical/json bootstrap used as fallback
wrong version accepted without compatibility validation

references.purpose: Resolver locates the actual bootstrap artifact.
